subtitle_zh: 阵位、装备、兵器、敌情与奇遇，一页备战。
subtitle_en: Posts, gear, weapons, threats, and encounters for the next watch.

scout.tip_zh: 数量多、生命低；用范围与穿透兵器压住第一波。
scout.tip_en: Many and fragile; area and piercing weapons control the opening wave.

ronin.tip_zh: 中速近战，常混在斥候后推进；保持侧向移动，别被包夹。
ronin.tip_en: Medium-speed melee that follows the scouts; keep sidestepping so they cannot surround you.

shield.tip_zh: 有 18% 减伤且移动慢；用击退、穿透和灼烧磨开盾线。
shield.tip_en: Slow with 18% damage reduction; wear the shield line down with knockback, pierce, and burn.

gun.tip_zh: 近距离单发火铳，横向移动即可躲开；贴近后它装填很慢。
gun.tip_en: A single close-range shot: strafe to dodge it, then close while it reloads.

archer.tip_zh: 射程最远；优先借掩体贴近，先清远程再收近战。
archer.tip_en: Longest reach; use cover to close in and clear the ranged line before the melee.

banner.tip_zh: 携带支援光环，优先击杀；旗倒后周围压力会明显下降。
banner.tip_en: A support aura makes it a priority target; the pressure drops when the banner falls.

cavalry.tip_zh: 每次生成会随机成为骑刀近战或骑弓远程；用枪线、击退与横向移动拆开马速。
cavalry.tip_en: Each spawn rolls either a saber rider or a horse archer; break their speed with spear lines, knockback, and lateral movement.

general.tip_zh: 2:00 起随龙鳞事件出现；装备与坐骑按局内种子随机，可能步行、骑枪或骑射。冲锋前横向位移。
general.tip_en: Appears with the 2:00 dragon-scale event; gear and mount roll from the run seed, so it may fight on foot, with a lance, or as a horse archer. Sidestep the charge.

daimyo.tip_zh: 15:30 Boss，高血高伤，也会随机骑乘或使用远程兵装；保留龙鳞清屏与爆发，绕背躲冲锋。
daimyo.tip_en: The 15:30 boss has high health and damage, and can also roll a mount or ranged loadout. Save a dragon-scale clear and burst, and circle behind its charge.

tideland.tip_zh: 开阔滩涂，潮沟会切割追击线；适合绕行拉怪，但不要在浅水区停步。
tideland.tip_en: Open flats and tidal cuts break pursuit lines; kite around them, but never stop in the shallows.

watergate.tip_zh: 水门与桥面形成瓶颈；把敌潮拉进窄口，再用范围兵器收割。
watergate.tip_en: Water gates and bridges form chokepoints; draw the tide into a narrow mouth and harvest with area weapons.

crossstreet.tip_zh: 敌血与敌速更高，刷新反而更少；沿十字主街机动，别在巷口被合围。
crossstreet.tip_en: Enemies are faster and tougher but spawn less often; move along the crossroads and avoid being boxed in at lane mouths.

facts_zh: 宁村所与永昌堡相隔一百七十余年，同守浙南沿海。
汤和巡海筑所、王德移师殉国、王氏聚族筑堡，串起两堡记忆。
方志、堡史与地方信俗，各自保存着这段海防往事。
facts_en: Ningcun and Yongchang stand more than 170 years apart on the same coast.
Tang He's garrison, Wang De's final march, and the Wang clan's fort bind their memories together.
Gazetteers, fort histories, and local traditions each preserve part of this coastal past.

left.lead_zh: 汤和主持筑所城，留制度与海防网络。
left.lead_en: Tang He built the garrison and left behind an institutional coastal network.
points_zh: 洪武十九年，汤和筑宁村所；洪武二十年所城成。
“寓兵于民”把乡兵、屯田与海防接到一起。
宁村汤和庙原名“东瓯襄武王汤公庙”，与永昌堡东瓯王庙不是同一座庙。
points_en: In 1386 Tang He built Ningcun garrison; it was completed in 1387.
The 'soldiers among the people' system linked militia, farmland, and coastal defence.
Ningcun's Tang He temple was originally the Dong'ou Xiangwu Wang Tang Gong temple; it is not Yongchang's Dong'ou King temple.
left.source_ref: 《汤和信俗·抵御倭患第一人》；《意绘抗倭英雄汤和》

bridge.body_zh: 嘉靖三十七年四月十九日，王德为解温州府城之围，移师宁村策应。四月二十日，他从宁村方向驰援，在金岙遭伏殉国。
bridge.body_en: On 19 April 1558 Wang De moved to Ningcun to relieve Wenzhou. On 20 April he rode out from Ningcun and was ambushed and killed at Jin'ao.
bridge.source_ref: 《永昌堡：十三进士与抗倭纪略》

right.lead_zh: 王沛、王德死后，王氏筑堡；王叔杲留下《沿海事宜》。
right.lead_en: After Wang Pei and Wang De died, the Wang clan built the fort; Wang Shugao left the 'Coastal Affairs' assessment.
points_zh: 嘉靖三十七年至三十八年，王氏筑永昌堡。
王叔杲《沿海事宜》评估宁村渡口、宁村马道与国初卫所部署。
1648 年宁村所被攻破，永昌堡独守八十余日，形成官堡/民堡对照。
points_en: The Wang clan built Yongchang Fort in 1558–1559.
Wang Shugao's 'Coastal Affairs' assessed Ningcun's ferry, horse road, and early-Ming garrison layout.
In 1648 Ningcun fell while Yongchang held out for over eighty days, a contrast between official and civic forts.
right.source_ref: 《永昌堡：十三进士与抗倭纪略》

timeline.zh: 王德移师宁村，次日殉国金岙
timeline.en: Wang De moves to Ningcun; dies at Jin'ao the next day

timeline.zh: 宁村破，永昌独守八十余日
timeline.en: Ningcun falls; Yongchang holds for over eighty days

timeline.zh: 汤和诞辰七百周年，五龙拼“天下太平”
timeline.en: Tang He's 700th anniversary; five dragon lanterns spell peace

do_not_claim_zh: 永昌堡东瓯王庙祀汉东瓯王驺摇，与宁村汤和庙各有香火；1559 年的守夜故事，承接的是汤和海防遗绪与王氏筑堡记忆。
do_not_claim_en: Yongchang's Dong'ou King temple honours the Han-era Zoyao, while Ningcun remembers Tang He at its own shrine. The 1559 watch carries forward Tang He's coastal legacy and the Wang clan's fort-building memory.

culture_sections.title_zh: 宁村所：把海防落到乡里
culture_sections.title_en: Ningcun Garrison: Coastal Defence in Local Hands
culture_sections.body_zh: 洪武十九年，汤和主持筑宁村所，次年所城告成。它不是一个孤立的城圈，而是明初沿海卫所、烽堠与乡兵网络的一环。所谓“寓兵于民”，并不是人人都是职业军人，而是让屯田、差役与海防在同一套地方秩序里运转：平时耕作，有警则守；官军负责号令与调度，乡里提供熟悉道路、潮汐和港湾的人力。理解这层制度，才能明白 1386 年的宁村与 1559 年的永昌并非简单的“同一座城”，而是一条海防传统在不同年代、不同主持者手里的延续。
culture_sections.body_en: In 1386 Tang He directed the building of Ningcun garrison, which was completed the following year. It was not an isolated fort but one link in the early-Ming network of coastal garrisons, beacon posts, and local militia. 'Soldiers among the people' did not mean that everyone was a professional soldier. It meant that farming, corvée, and coastal defence worked through one local order: fields in peacetime, watches in an alarm; officials commanded, while local people supplied knowledge of roads, tides, and harbours. This institution is why 1386 Ningcun and 1559 Yongchang are not simply 'the same fort': they are stages of one coastal tradition, carried by different communities and leaders.
culture_sections.source_ref: 《汤和信俗·抵御倭患第一人》；《意绘抗倭英雄汤和》

culture_sections.title_zh: 永昌堡：王氏为何要筑一座民堡
culture_sections.title_en: Yongchang Fort: Why the Wang Clan Built a Civic Fort
culture_sections.body_zh: 嘉靖三十七年，王德为解温州府城之围移师宁村，次日从宁村方向驰援，在金岙遭伏殉国；王沛亦在此前遇难。接连的牺牲让王氏宗族认识到，仅靠远处官军的驰援不够快。嘉靖三十七年至三十八年，王氏聚族筑永昌堡，把宗祠、宅第、街巷、水门与防御墙放进同一个生活空间。城墙以夯土夹碎石层层夯实，城门与水门既管出入，也管潮汐与供水。它因此不是一座纯军事要塞，而是“家族把身家性命围起来”的民堡。1648 年宁村所被攻破时，永昌堡独守八十余日，这个对照正说明官堡与民堡在组织方式上的差别。
culture_sections.body_en: In 1558 Wang De moved to Ningcun to relieve Wenzhou. The next day he rode out from Ningcun and was ambushed and killed at Jin'ao; Wang Pei had died shortly before. Those losses taught the Wang clan that relief from a distant garrison might always arrive too late. Between 1558 and 1559 the clan built Yongchang Fort, placing ancestral halls, homes, lanes, water gates, and defensive walls inside one lived space. The walls were rammed earth packed with rubble in layers; the gates and water gates controlled movement, tides, and water supply. It was therefore not a purely military stronghold but a civic fort built by a clan around its own households. In 1648 Ningcun fell while Yongchang held for over eighty days, a contrast that reveals how official garrisons and clan forts organised defence differently.
culture_sections.source_ref: 《永昌堡：十三进士与抗倭纪略》

culture_sections.title_zh: 灯油、巡夜与军市：守夜生活的游戏化
culture_sections.title_en: Lamp Oil, Night Patrols, and the Market: A Playable Night Watch
culture_sections.body_zh: 历史上的城防不会把“灯油”量化成六格生命线，也不会让守夜人在战场上用军功即时招募友军。游戏把这些生活经验压缩成可读的规则：灯油代表可见范围与安全感，油尽意味着黑暗逼近；巡夜脚步对应走位与绕行；军市把乡里互助、雇募与临时结盟变成一次选择。这里的“灯下军市”是玩法演绎，不是明代市场的逐字复原。它保留的核心问题是真实的：一座民堡要在夜里持续运转，必须有油、有粮、有轮班的人，也要有愿意在墙下多守一刻的邻人。
culture_sections.body_en: Historical city defence did not measure lamp oil as six segments of a life bar, nor did night watchmen recruit allies on a battlefield with immediate merit. The game compresses lived experience into readable rules: oil stands for visibility and a sense of safety; running dry means the dark closes in. The rhythm of patrol becomes movement and kiting. The lamp market turns local mutual aid, hiring, and temporary alliance into a choice. This 'market beneath the lamps' is a gameplay dramatisation, not a literal reconstruction of a Ming market. Its central question remains historical: a civic fort could keep working through the night only with oil, grain, rotating watches, and neighbours willing to hold the wall a little longer.
culture_sections.source_ref: 演绎：《永昌堡与汤和关系索引》

culture_sections.title_en: Five-Colour Dragon Lanterns and 'Peace Under Heaven'
culture_sections.body_zh: 宁村汤和信俗与拼字龙灯，把纪念从庙堂延伸到街巷。龙灯由多人执举，转向、起伏、拼字都要求整队同步；五色纸鳞在灯影里翻动，远看像一条会呼吸的河。地方记忆把汤和巡海、筑所与护民连在一起，今天的文化节则用巡游、祭仪和龙灯重述这段关系。2026 年是汤和诞辰七百周年，五龙拼出“天下太平”，既是祝词，也是一种朴素的海边愿望：船能回港，田能收成，夜里不用再敲警锣。
culture_sections.body_en: Ningcun's Tang He tradition and its character-forming dragon lanterns carry commemoration from the shrine into the lanes. The dragon is lifted by many bearers; turns, rises, dips, and written characters all require the whole line to move as one. Five-colour paper scales shift in the lamplight until the dragon looks like a breathing river. Local memory joins Tang He's coastal inspection, garrison building, and protection of the people; today's cultural festival retells that relationship through procession, ritual, and lanterns. In 2026, the 700th anniversary of Tang He's birth, five dragons spell 'peace under heaven'—a blessing and a plain coastal wish: boats home, fields harvested, and no alarm gong in the night.
culture_sections.source_ref: 清《永嘉县志·岁时》 · 宁村拼字龙灯

culture_sections.title_zh: 两座庙，不要把记忆混成一座
culture_sections.body_zh: 宁村的汤和庙原名“东瓯襄武王汤公庙”，纪念的是明代汤和及其海防经营；永昌堡的东瓯王庙祀汉代东瓯王驺摇，属于另一条地方记忆。两座庙都在浙南沿海，都参与地方信俗，却不能因为名字里都有“东瓯”就合并成同一座庙，也不能把永昌堡说成汤和亲筑。1559 年守夜故事真正承接的，是汤和留下的海防遗绪、王德与王沛的牺牲，以及王氏宗族筑堡自守的选择。把这三层分开，文化叙事才不会用一句方便的传说覆盖复杂历史。
culture_sections.body_en: Ningcun's Tang He temple was originally the Dong'ou Xiangwu Wang Tang Gong temple, commemorating the Ming official Tang He and his coastal defence work. Yongchang's Dong'ou King temple honours the Han-era Zoyao and belongs to a different local memory. Both stand on the southern Zhejiang coast and both participate in local custom, but sharing the name 'Dong'ou' does not make them one temple, nor did Tang He personally build Yongchang Fort. The 1559 night watch inherits Tang He's coastal legacy, the sacrifices of Wang De and Wang Pei, and the Wang clan's decision to build and hold a fort. Keeping these layers separate prevents a convenient legend from swallowing a more complex history.
culture_sections.source_ref: 《永昌堡：十三进士与抗倭纪略》；《汤和信俗·抵御倭患第一人》
